name: Navarre Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Navarre Beach?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes; plain golf carts only on designated roads. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less in Navarre Beach; on Pensacola Beach that includes Via de Luna and Fort Pickens Road. Golf carts can't cross the Bob Sikes Bridge or the Navarre Bridge.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections
Registered LSVs may use Pensacola Beach roads signed 35 mph or less
Golf carts aren't allowed on the Bob Sikes Bridge
Golf carts on Navarre Beach county roads, not the Navarre Bridge
rules.citation: Santa Rosa County golf cart ordinance

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Navarre Beach?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on Via de Luna?
faq.a: Yes. Via de Luna is posted 35 mph or less, so registered LSVs may use it.

faq.q: Can I take a golf cart over the bridge to Pensacola?
faq.a: No. Golf carts aren't allowed on the Bob Sikes Bridge.
